Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: credit for pilot overage + extension

David / team,

Thanks for the note and attachment. Quick accounting guidance based on the facts provided:
- If this overage was an unbilled usage already included on a paid invoice, the correct instrument is a credit memo applied to the customer's AR balance (invoice offset). That maintains correct revenue recognition and clears the customer's payable.
- If the overage is being treated as a promotional/market development credit (not tied to an invoiced line), we can record a contra-revenue allowance. That has different disclosure and tax implications.

From the stub: it looks invoiced, so credit memo is preferable. For processing, we need: 1) final approved credit amount, 2) ledger GL mapping (we typically map to GLA 4012 for credit memos tied to product refunds), 3) the deal_id and approval evidence (AM email thread).

Approval matrix: amounts <= $5k can be approved by AM + Sales Ops. Anything > $5k requires Finance manager approval. This one (~$7.2k) will need my sign-off. Please prepare a one-page approval note and the proposed credit memo PDF. I can then sign and route to AR to post. Also confirm whether the customer wants the credit applied to the existing invoice or as a standalone credit memo for future invoices.

Neha
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

Hi Sam — thanks for the details and the invoice. Short answer: we can issue a credit memo for the invoiced overage and we are comfortable granting a two-week trial extension, contingent on a brief mutual action plan (MOP) describing the extension scope and acceptance criteria.

Proposed next steps (MOP / approval plan):
1) Redwood drafts proposed credit memo (we'll issue as invoice offset) and a one-page approval note for internal finance review.
2) Customer confirms whether credit should be applied to invoice #20280630 or held as a standalone credit for future billing.
3) Redwood Finance (Neha) will sign approval for the credit memo and route to AR for posting.
4) Upon finance sign-off, we issue the two-week trial extension tied to completion of integration checks (see short acceptance checklist in attached mutual_action_plan.xlsx).

I attached a draft credit memo (proposed_credit_memo_draft.pdf) and a MOP template (mutual_action_plan.xlsx) showing dates and acceptance criteria. If that works, confirm and we'll move it through finance.

Best,
David
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
